english.note: Use this polite question pattern when asking permission for yourself or asking someone else to do V.
Use 可唔可以 + V to make a typically polite request.

examples.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 jap6 lei4 aa3

examples.english: Can you lend me a pen?
examples.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 zi1 bat1 bei2 ngo5
